title: K0 source provenance is orthogonal to semantic ASR
basis: LCP-0003, P6, P8, PIPE-002, PIPE-006, PIPE-009, and PIPE-010
decision: Publish an exact companion source map from resolved-ASR JSON Pointers to original UTF-8 byte ranges, while excluding all provenance from semantic identities and hashes.
dissent: A companion artifact requires consumers to retain and bind two files.
JSON Pointer paths can shift after semantic tree edits even when a declaration identity survives.
Line and column displays remain derived and can differ across user interfaces.

compatibility.source: Non-ASCII UTF-8 remains forbidden as a token but is explicitly allowed inside comments.
compatibility.semantic: Resolved ASR and contract hashes exclude provenance and remain trivia-independent.
compatibility.proof: Future translation proofs can bind diagnostics and Core nodes to an independently audited source object.
compatibility.artifact: A new source-map artifact and its independent hash are required for audited resolver output.
compatibility.tooling: Consumers must keep source maps separate from semantic ASR hashing.
